deploy.$comment: boot.py seeds the stores and then execs the API — it is not a wrapper that can be skipped. A startCommand of `python -m core.api.app` boots an API over an empty volume, because Kuzu is single-writer and the API holds the lock.
deploy.$timeout_comment: The FIRST boot on a fresh volume does real work before the API binds: deep-tier fetch+load, the GDELT artifact, the full-archive study and the forecast freeze. Later boots skip the loaded parts and come up in under a minute.
